answer: Each identity must unlock a vault: the beacon emits a dawn signal each epoch, and the agent must plant a unique flag on the knoll. The first key turn costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent turn doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at turn 14 (20.4 M iterations). A knoll audit verifies each flag against the epoch seed; any missing flag voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full vault cost because each flag binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
